title: I TRUST MY JUDGMENT AND MY INSTINCTS
note: Not released. Song: I Trust My Judgment and My Instincts (3:21, bass-house and hip-hop, 130 BPM), Suno take 914ea1c7. 3:21: post the whole vertical render on every platform. Covers: make in ChatGPT from the FREQ 001 cover, lines I TRUST MY|JUDGMENT. Calendar: freq/CALENDAR.md.
alt_text: A gold frequency ring glows around the NDCH arch-and-Y emblem on black stone veined with gold, under the title I TRUST MY JUDGMENT AND MY INSTINCTS, NDCH FREQ 003. The picture pushes in slowly and the gold breathes brighter while one line repeats: I trust my judgment and my instincts.

location.name: Walden Pond State Reservation
location.why: Emerson owned the land where Thoreau built his cabin, and Emerson's Self-Reliance says it plainly: Trust thyself. FREQ 001 began with Know thyself at Delphi; this is the next line.
